content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. or an equivalent degree, preferably with a minimum of 60% marks, with any national exam qualified (NET/GATE) Experience: Prior research experience in neuroscience and animal handling will be given preference.
